question: The Centre scrapped Article 370 of the Constitution in 2019. This article granted special status to ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 370** of the Indian Constitution granted special status to **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• **This special status allowed Jammu and Kashmir to have its own Constitution, flag, and autonomy over internal administration.**
 
• The Centre scrapped Article 370 on August 5, 2019, which led to the reorganization of the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories
 
• **Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.**
 
• The move was aimed at bringing Jammu and Kashmir into** **mainstream India and promoting development in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Himachal Pradesh is a state in northern India, known for its scenic beauty and tourism.**
 
• Punjab is a state in northern India, known for its rich culture, agriculture, and industry.
 
• Uttar Pradesh is a state in northern India, known for its historical and cultural significance, as well as being the most populous state in India.
